# WALOO

> Custom web design and development studio. UX/UI, WordPress, Design to Code, ecommerce, and Core Web Vitals — performance budgets on every engagement.

WALOO Digital LLC (waloo.co) is a boutique team with 15+ years and 100+ WordPress builds. We design and ship production sites and apps for marketing, product, and enterprise teams. English-only public site. Primary CTA: request a free technical audit.

## Services

- [Services hub](https://waloo.co/services/): What we do — five focused offerings
- [WordPress development](https://waloo.co/services/wordpress-development/): Custom themes, plugins, headless, migrations, support
- [UX/UI design](https://waloo.co/services/ux-ui-design/): Journeys, Figma systems, handoff for production
- [Design to Code](https://waloo.co/services/design-to-code/): Figma to HTML/CSS/JS, WordPress, or other frontends
- [Ecommerce](https://waloo.co/services/ecommerce/): WooCommerce and Shopify stores built for campaign load
- [Core Web Vitals](https://waloo.co/services/core-web-vitals/): WordPress speed audits and ranked remediation
